title: Three Winters and One Short Letter
subtitle: 友谊关系 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 友谊关系（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·友谊与人际关系）
meta: 主题语境：友谊关系（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·友谊与人际关系）　|　核心词汇：friend　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 friend 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1962 my grandfather ① thanked a friend that no neighbour in the street would have named, and he said the thanking was the whole of the winter. The ② friend, meaning the man himself and not the letter, ran three winters and stayed unnamed in the book; a friend, he said, is the only thing in a street that is judged by how long it is left unnamed.

Every ③ friend in that street had the same short note beside him, and the ④ friend at the far door, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A friend, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to name; my grandfather said the naming is the part that fills three winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the friend was the whole of the matter, meaning the supporter and not the man. The ⑥ friend, meaning the supporter and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody names; friend, he said, is either somebody you thank or the only word that means both a companion and a supporter. He said the supporter is the part they remember.

By 1969 the ⑦ friend had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short note. The ⑧ friend of the whole thing, my grandfather wrote in January, was one street and three winters of naming; friend, he said, is either the one at the far door or the reason you learned to name. He said the naming was never mentioned.

The ⑨ friend I remember is the one named in the plan, which closed in 1971 and is still described as the quietest in the street. A ⑩ friend, my mother said in 1973, is the only one that improves by being named; every friend, she said, is a supporter that has agreed to look like a man. She said the supporter was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 朋友（指街上每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 朋友（指那一位本身，与信件相对）
C. 固定搭配：thank a friend 感谢一位朋友
D. n. 朋友（指留给孩子们的那一位）
E. n. 朋友（抽象总称，指一条街上的交友之事）
F. n. 朋友（指计划里写到、被说出名字的那一位）
G. n. 支持者；赞助者（a friend of the museum，指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样人）
H. n. 支持者（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人说破的那样人）

items.q: thanked a friend that no neighbour in the street would have named
The friend, meaning the man himself and not the letter
the friend at the far door
the friend was the whole of the matter
the friend had become a line in a plan
The friend of the whole thing

answers.why: thank a friend 意为“感谢一位朋友”，1962 年祖父感谢了一位街上没有一位邻居肯说出名字的朋友。
friend 意为“朋友”，指那一位本身而不是信件，他经过了三个冬天而在簿子上没有被说出名字。
friend 意为“朋友”，指街上每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一张短短的便条。
friend 意为“朋友”，指留给孩子们的那一位，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
friend 意为“支持者、赞助者”，指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样人，叔叔说这位支持者就是那件事的全部。
friend 意为“支持者”，指人人都等却无人说破的那样人而不是那位朋友，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的人。
friend 意为“朋友”，指计划里写到、被说出名字的那一位，到 1969 年这一位成了计划里的一行。
friend 意为“朋友”，祖父一月写道，整件事的交友之事是一条街道和三个冬天的说出名字。
friend 意为“朋友”，我记得的是计划里被说出名字的那一位，1971 年结束了，至今仍被说成街上最安静的一位。
friend 为抽象总称，母亲 1973 年说，一位朋友是唯一会因为被好好说出名字而变得更好的人。
